## 5. Economizing expenditure on running cost of staff cars  
The ceiling for fuel consumption for each staff car is fixed at 250 litres per month. Payment for over the stipulated limit shall be made only with the approval of Administrative Secretary and the concurrence of Financial Adviser.  
Parking of Government cars in the residence of officers or drivers  
should be avoided keeping in mind the consumption of dead mileage.
